map_id_loop_emulation.scope: Untouched instructions 0x4425E4E until 0x4425EAA/EC2; three SQLite veneers return fixture rows. Synthetic caller map-ID RAM, no file/device reads from emulated firmware. Stops before allocation, metadata parsing or query execution.

assertions.claim: Address manager creation has conditional provider dispatch, not a single unconditional JAI call.
assertions.detail: Selector checks region guard plus format constants 950, 932, 936, 1252; otherwise enum 4 allocates base GUI::PrefectureManager. Enum 0 reads runtime halfword 0x5431A94; 1 creates WeakPrefectureManager and 2 creates PrefectureManagerTwn.

assertions.claim: The 950-format guard also requires a matching map-id record with its top bit set.
assertions.detail: 0x32DF7C..82 compares loaded record halfword +0x28 with the supplied format constant; 0x32DF84..90 calls 0x32C940 with low 28 bits of the map ID and requires true. 0x32C9AC..AE returns the matching record bit 31. UI checkbox ownership of this flag is unresolved.

assertions.claim: JAI database initialization checks caller-supplied map IDs against jai_map_id.
assertions.detail: SQL table +4 is prepared at 0x4425E36; map_id column at 0x4425E74 is compared to caller array at 0x4425E80..92. In the clean row path a first unrequested DB ID or unmatched requested-count returns status 3. Only this stock loop is emulated; database enumeration, UI and maps are not.

assertions.claim: The original TWNJAI database depends on Address Point map 0x53061A, not main road map 0x533A5C.
assertions.detail: jai_map_id contains 5441050, matching gmapprom1.img MPS hex_map_number and I053061A.GMP. The main and address layers are complementary stock products; this is not evidence that their original simultaneous selection conflicts.

assertions.claim: A JAI query path uses FTS MATCH against a partitioned japan_addr_index table and prepares/binds the actual SQL.
assertions.detail: 0x442599A..B6 loads query table +8/+C/+10/+14 then calls 0x4424A84 at 0x44259BC. 0x4424C1C prepares the built SQL, 0x4424C36 binds text through veneer 0x448E050. Observed DB tk tokens are not decoded; origin and meaning of the query transformation remain unknown.

assertions.claim: Cannot yet establish that the fallback base manager specifically searches OSM MDR, or that selected Taiwan address searches always use JAI.
assertions.detail: TWN depth dispatch chooses virtual method +0x48 or base helper 0x440E844, but the provider from its shared object and MDR search implementation are not resolved. Runtime profile, optional-copy startup flag and actual checkbox state are unavailable.

limitations: No physical device, live RAM, checkbox flag writer, country-selection state or search timing observed.
Optional runtime code comes from exact startup mappings; live copy flag is not established.
Bounded functions leave indirect virtual providers and callees unresolved.
The tk encoder and original Taiwanese search sort/transliteration semantics are not identified.
